subject: Scaling x-y axis within individual plots of a facet wrap

messages.author: 0cbfcab2e3c1b053
messages.subject: Scaling x-y axis within individual plots of a facet wrap
parts:
Hello

Is it possible to individually scale separate panels for the x-y axis
within facet wrap? For example 1 panel needs to be 0 to 2, 2nd 0 to
10, with an aspect ratio of 1.
eg.

[ ggplot(data.frame(rfa=1:2,x=c(1,20),y=c(2,10))) +
geom_point(aes(x,y)) +
facet_wrap(~rfa, scale="free") +
coord_equal(ratio=1)

Many thanks, emperorfish
